mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT v.* FROM video v JOIN video_category vc ON v.id = vc.v_id JOIN category c ON vc.c_id = c.id WHERE c.id = 14 ORDER BY v.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT v.* FROM video v JOIN video_category vc ON v.id = vc.v_id JOIN category c ON vc.c_id = c.id WHERE c.id = 15 ORDER BY v.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT v.* FROM video v JOIN video_category vc ON v.id = vc.v_id JOIN category c ON vc.c_id = c.id WHERE c.id = 16 ORDER BY v.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT v.* FROM video v INNER JOIN video_category vc ON v.id = vc.v_id WHERE 1=1
AND v.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{kw},'%')
AND vc.c_id = #{cid}
ORDER BY v.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT v.* FROM video v INNER JOIN video_category vc ON v.id = vc.v_id WHERE vc.c_id = #{mainCid} ORDER BY v.id DESC

SELECT v.*, c.id AS cat_id, c.name AS cat_name FROM video v -- 关联中间表拿分类id LEFT JOIN video_category vc ON v.id = vc.v_id -- 关联分类表拿分类名称 LEFT JOIN category c ON vc.c_id = c.id -- 只筛选电视剧：必须绑定大类id=11 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM video_category vc2 WHERE vc2.v_id = v.id AND vc2.c_id = 11 ) ORDER BY v.id DESC
